records.jp: ここって、私の家！？
records.en_original: Wait, is this...my house?!
records.en: Wait, is this...my house?!

records.jp: どうしてここに……っ！？
records.en_original: Why are we here?!
records.en: Why are we here?!

records.jp: 陽桜莉、あそこにいるのって！
records.en_original: Hiori, look over there!
records.en: Hiori, look over there!

records.jp: お姉ちゃん！
records.en_original: Sis!
records.en: Onee-chan!

records.jp: 待って陽桜莉、なんだか様子が変……
records.en_original: Wait, Hiori—something seems off...
records.en: Wait, Hiori—something seems off...

records.jp: 上手く、やれていると思っていた
records.en_original: I thought I was handling everything well.
records.en: I thought I was handling everything well.

records.jp: 母が失踪したあの日から、<CR>私と陽桜莉の二人暮らしが始まった
records.en_original: Ever since the day Mom disappeared, it was just Hiori and me living together.
records.en: Ever since the day Mom disappeared, it was just Hiori and me living together.

records.jp: 始めは帰ってくると信じていた期待も、<CR>四年が経つ頃には消えていた
records.en_original: At first, I hoped Mom would come back, but after four years, even that hope faded away.
records.en: At first, I hoped Mom would come back, but after four years, even that hope faded away.

records.jp: 部屋を貸してくれている親切な親戚は、<CR>私たちを心配し頻繁に連絡をしてきてくれた
records.en_original: The kind relative who let us borrow this room would worry about us and contact us a lot.
records.en: The kind relative who let us borrow this room would worry about us and contact us a lot.

records.jp: 部屋を引き払い、親戚の家で一緒に暮らさないかという<CR>ありがたい誘い
records.en_original: They kindly offered for us to move out and live with them at their house together.
records.en: They kindly offered for us to move out and live with them at their house together.

records.jp: その親切に私は何度も心の中で感謝し、<CR>何度もすがりたい気持ちに襲われた
records.en_original: I was so grateful for their kindness. Deep down, so many times, there were moments I wanted to take them up on that offer.
records.en: I was so grateful for their kindness. Deep down, so many times, there were moments I wanted to take them up on that offer.

records.jp: けれど、それはできなかった
records.en_original: But...I just couldn't do it.
records.en: But...I just couldn't do it.

records.jp: 陽桜莉が母の帰りを信じていたから
records.en_original: Because Hiori still believed Mom would come back.
records.en: Because Hiori still believed Mom would come back.

records.jp: だから、私も信じ続けなければいけなかった
records.en_original: So I had to keep believing too.
records.en: So I had to keep believing too.

records.jp: すべては陽桜莉のため。<CR>陽桜莉には、ずっと笑っていてほしかったから
records.en_original: Everything I did was for Hiori. I just wanted to see her keep smiling.
records.en: Everything I did was for Hiori. I just wanted to see her keep smiling.

records.jp: そのためならば、私はどんな苦難も受け入れる。<CR>どんなことだってすると心に誓っていた
records.en_original: For that, I was ready to take on any hardship. Ready to do whatever it took—I vowed that to myself.
records.en: For that, I was ready to take on any hardship. Ready to do whatever it took—I vowed that to myself.

records.jp: そんな生活を送っていたある日、<CR>ユズとライムが私の前に現れた
records.en_original: Then one day, Yuzu and Lime appeared before me.
records.en: Then one day, Yuzu and Lime appeared before me.

records.jp: 想いの力を強く持つ私は、人の想いを守る存在、<CR>リフレクターになる素質があると言われた
records.en_original: They told me that because I have strong emotions, I have the potential to become a Reflector—someone who protects people's hearts.
records.en: They told me that because I have strong emotions, I have the potential to become a Reflector—someone who protects people's hearts.

records.jp: そして、リフレクターとしてみんなの想いを守り、<CR>世界を救ったとき――
records.en_original: And that if I could protect everyone's feelings and save the world as a Reflector—
records.en: And that if I could protect everyone's feelings and save the world as a Reflector—

records.jp: 一つだけ、願いが叶うと……
records.en_original: A wish of mine would be granted...
records.en: A wish of mine would be granted...

records.jp: 私が拒む理由はなかった
records.en_original: I had no reason to refuse.
records.en: I had no reason to refuse.

records.jp: リフレクターとして、私は大勢の少女たちの<CR>想いを守り続けた
records.en_original: As a Reflector, I kept on protecting the hearts of so many girls.
records.en: As a Reflector, I kept on protecting the hearts of so many girls.

records.jp: けれど、何度も暴走を繰り返す少女と出会い、<CR>ある疑念が生まれた
records.en_original: But after meeting a girl who kept losing control, I started to have doubts.
records.en: But after meeting a girl who kept losing control, I started to have doubts.

records.jp: リフレクターは、本当に誰かを守れるのだろうか、と
records.en_original: Can a Reflector truly protect anyone?
records.en: Can a Reflector truly protect anyone?

records.jp: それでも、願いを叶えたいという一心で、<CR>私はリフレクターとしての活動を続けていた
records.en_original: Even so, I kept working as a Reflector, driven by my desire to have my wish granted.
records.en: Even so, I kept working as a Reflector, driven by my desire to have my wish granted.

records.jp: けれど私は、陽桜莉が絶望を抱えていることに<CR>気づくことができなかった
records.en_original: But it kept me from seeing that Hiori was drowning in despair.
records.en: But it kept me from seeing that Hiori was drowning in despair.

records.jp: 私の願い……それはたった一人の大切な家族、<CR>陽桜莉の幸せだったのに……
records.en_original: My wish...it was for the happiness of my one and only precious sister—Hiori...
records.en: My wish...it was for the happiness of my one and only precious sister—Hiori...

records.jp: その陽桜莉を失った私には、もう戦う気力も、<CR>誰かを守る理由さえもなくなり――
records.en_original: After I lost Hiori, I lost the will to fight. I didn't even have a reason to protect anyone any longer...
records.en: After I lost Hiori, I lost the will to fight. I didn't even have a reason to protect anyone any longer...

records.jp: 原種との戦いを途中で放棄したことにより、<CR>月ノ宮は滅ぶこととなった
records.en_original: Because I abandoned the fight with the Sephira, Tsukinomiya was destroyed.
records.en: Because I abandoned the fight with the Sephira, Tsukinomiya was destroyed.

records.jp: やがて、誰かは知らないリフレクターが、<CR>原種を倒したことで時間が戻った
records.en_original: I don't know who, but some Reflector eventually defeated the Sephira and time was reset.
records.en: I don't know who, but some Reflector eventually defeated the Sephira and time was reset.

records.jp: 今の世界が生まれたことで、<CR>もう一度やり直すチャンスを手に入れた
records.en_original: Now, with this new world, I was given another chance to start over.
records.en: Now, with this new world, I was given another chance to start over.

records.jp: 今度こそ、私は間違った選択はしない
records.en_original: This time, I won't make the wrong choice.
records.en: This time, I won't make the wrong choice.

records.jp: 前の世界のような悲劇を繰り返したりはしない
records.en_original: I won't let the same tragedy unfold as it did in the previous world.
records.en: I won't let the same tragedy unfold as it did in the previous world.

records.jp: 陽桜莉を、絶対に絶望させたりはしない。<CR>どんなことをしようとも……
records.en_original: I'll never let Hiori fall into despair again—no matter what.
records.en: I'll never let Hiori fall into despair again—no matter what.

records.jp: 私は紫乃の目的である世界の創造……、<CR>想いを管理下においた世界を創ることに決めた
records.en_original: So I decided to help Shino create the world she wishes for... A world where everyone's feelings are kept under control.
records.en: So I decided to help Shino create the world she wishes for... A world where everyone's feelings are kept under control.

records.jp: けど……それが間違いだった
records.en_original: But that was a mistake.
records.en: But that was a mistake.

records.jp: いつの間にか自分と陽桜莉の境界がわからなくなり、<CR>陽桜莉のことを自分のことのように考えて
records.en_original: Without realizing it, I couldn't tell where I ended and Hiori began, and started seeing her as part of myself.
records.en: Without realizing it, I couldn't tell where I ended and Hiori began, and started seeing her as part of myself.

records.jp: 自分の幸せを陽桜莉の幸せのように決めつけて、<CR>それが陽桜莉を傷つけることになっていた
records.en_original: I assumed that my happiness was the same as Hiori's, and it ended up hurting her.
records.en: I assumed that my happiness was the same as Hiori's, and it ended up hurting her.

records.jp: それに気づかせてくれたのは陽桜莉と、<CR>陽桜莉を大切に想ってくれる仲間たちの言葉だった
records.en_original: It was Hiori and the friends who truly cared about her whose words finally made me realize that.
records.en: It was Hiori and the friends who truly cared about her whose words finally made me realize that.

records.jp: 数えきれない人たちのフラグメントを奪ってきた
records.en_original: I stole countless Fragments from so many people.
records.en: I stole countless Fragments from so many people.

records.jp: 大切なバディのモモのフラグメントを破壊し、<CR>何よりも大切な陽桜莉を苦しめ続けてきた
records.en_original: I destroyed the Fragment of my precious friend Momo, and caused endless suffering to Hiori—the person who means the most to me.
records.en: I destroyed the Fragment of my precious friend Momo, and caused endless suffering to Hiori—the person who means the most to me.

records.jp: 今の私は、その罪を償うために陽桜莉たちと共に歩む
records.en_original: Now, I fight together with Hiori and the others to atone for that crime.
records.en: Now, I fight together with Hiori and the others to atone for that crime.

records.jp: 大切な陽桜莉と、陽桜莉の大切な人たちがいる<CR>この世界を守るために
records.en_original: To protect Hiori and the people most important to her in this world.
records.en: To protect Hiori and the people most important to her in this world.

records.jp: お姉ちゃんのせいじゃない
records.en_original: It's not your fault, Sis.
records.en: It's not your fault, Onee-chan.

records.jp: 私のせいだ……私の心が弱かったから、<CR>そのせいで前の世界も、お姉ちゃんも……
records.en_original: It's mine... My heart was weak. That's why the previous world and you ended up that way...
records.en: It's mine... My heart was weak.<CR>That's why the previous world, and Onee-chan...

records.jp: でも、もう前みたいにはならない
records.en_original: But things won't be like that anymore.
records.en: But things won't be like that anymore.

records.jp: 私は、絶対に絶望しない。<CR>誰も絶望させない
records.en_original: I won't ever fall into despair again. And I won't let anyone else, either.
records.en: I won't ever fall into despair again. And I won't let anyone else, either.

records.jp: もし陽桜莉が絶望しそうになったりしたら、<CR>無理やりにでもそこから引き上げる
records.en_original: If you're ever about to lose hope, I'll snap you out of it no matter what!
records.en: If you're ever about to lose hope, I'll snap you out of it no matter what!

records.jp: 大切なバディなんだから、ね
records.en_original: Because you're my precious partner, okay?
records.en: Because you're my precious partner, okay?

records.jp: えへへ……ありがとう、瑠夏ちゃん
records.en_original: Hehe... Thank you, Ruka.
records.en: Hehe... Thank you, Ruka-chan.
